title: The Casimir Effect
description: Two plates in a vacuum attract: empty space is full of energy. Unlocks the Casimir Press and Zero-Point Extractor.

puzzle.goal: Two uncharged, perfectly conducting plates face each other across a narrow gap in empty space. Only vacuum modes whose half-wavelengths fit the gap survive between them. Sum the zero-point energy ½ħω of every allowed mode between the plates, subtract the same sum for free space, and write the energy per unit plate area as a function of the gap a.
puzzle.name: Casimir energy (Casimir, 1948)
puzzle.ask: After regularising (the divergent parts cancel), the result is −π²ħc/(720a³). Find its magnitude for the gap given, in units where ħc = 1.
puzzle.method: Each standing mode across the gap has kz = nπ/a; the energy is a sum over n and an integral over in-plane k. Subtract the continuum and regularise with ζ(−3) = 1/120.
